author: Ryan Daws
description:
Microsoft has released MAI-Cyber-1-Flash, a security model built into MDASH that finds vulnerabilities at half the cost of alternatives. Redmond announced the model alongside Perception – a set of security agents – in a joint post from Mustafa Suleyman, CEO of Microsoft AI, and Hayete Gallot, Executive VP of Microsoft Security.
